text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my way to the track, I am
intercepted by a
visibly chipper Taiki
Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Get a load of this, Trainer! I just got
invited to go
partner runnin' again!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, your fault! The gal who asked said she could learn a lot from me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
She was keen on finding out how I
spiced up my
runnin' so much!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So I told her it was your fault for
expanding my
horizons!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You taught me about a world where
speed alone
won't score ya wins. Now I
get flutters thinkin'
about how to
overcome it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been able to cool off since the
day we
met, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm always burnin' up with passion...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You better take responsibility for lettin'
me in on
something so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna forge this future of ours
together!
Back out now, and I'm huntin'
ya down! Bang!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I appreciate the thought, I should
probably
do something about her choice
of language
before someone gets the
wrong idea.
